assumptions: critical_swimming_speed_m_s = 0.35 (~10 SL/s, typical adult zebrafish Ucrit)
current_speed_m_s = 0.15 (well below Ucrit, ~4 SL/s, sustainable hold)
bladder_volume_surface_ml = 0.04 (~5% of ~0.8 ml body volume for near-neutral buoyancy)
bladder_volume_at_depth_ml = 0.03887 from Boyle's law at 0.3 m: 0.04/1.02905 (P=101325+1000*9.81*0.3 Pa)
powered = false and flight_mode = 'none' to state explicitly there is no flight; flight/aerobic-demand fields omitted on purpose
Energy budget, mass_change and genotype_edits omitted: no basis to choose them, avoids unforced violations
notes: I couldn't run lean_check, so none of this has been checked against it. No law blocks the brief as far as I can tell. Flight-related laws (C14, E3) should be out of scope because powered is false. The flight_mode value 'none' may not be a value lean_check recognises. If it isn't, 'glide' is the fallback, though that declares an unpowered glide, which isn't quite what the brief says. Laws that depend on omitted inputs, such as the energy budget, will probably return cannot-evaluate.
